title: BundleSuiteBulkAddRequestBulkAll
description: Add all test suites, with an optional list of IDs to exclude.

filter.description: Optional filter constraining which test cases the bulk 'all' selection resolves to. When search criteria are set, 'all' means all test cases matching the same search/filter shown in the UI (not every test case in the system), minus any excludeIds.

excludeIds.description: List of test suite IDs to exclude from the bulk add.

q.description: Free-text search term applied to the test cases (matches the UI search box).

testCaseStatus.description: Restrict to test cases with this latest execution status.

testCaseType.description: Restrict to column-level ('column'), table-level ('table'), or all ('all') test cases.

entityLink.description: Restrict to test cases under this entity link (e.g. a table).

includeAllTests.description: When an entityLink is set, prefix-match it so column tests under the entity are included.

columnName.description: Restrict to test cases on this column.
